claim_001.label: SUPPORTED
claim_001.text: For PEP 695 type parameter syntax, whitespace() returns no space before the opening '[' token of a type parameter list.

evidence.note: The change adds handling for syms.typeparams that returns NO when the token is LSQB.

claim_001.rationale: The behavior follows directly from the newly added whitespace rule.

claim_002.label: SUPPORTED
claim_002.text: The change was introduced to prevent unwanted whitespace from being reintroduced in PEP 695 type parameter formatting when lines are rebuilt during string processing.

evidence.note: The commit message explains that whitespace() should directly handle the cases because rebuilt lines could reintroduce spaces.

claim_002.rationale: The commit description explicitly identifies incorrect whitespace reintroduction as the motivation.

claim_003.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_003.text: The change was primarily introduced to improve formatter performance.
claim_003.rationale: No performance objective is stated in the diff or commit description.

claim_004.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_004.text: The change adds support for a new Python language syntax feature.
claim_004.rationale: The change adjusts formatting behavior for existing PEP 695 syntax rather than introducing parser support for new syntax.
